name: When should I consider non-slip flooring for my bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider non-slip flooring for my bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider non-slip flooring for your bathroom remodel if safety is a primary concern, especially for households with children, elderly individuals, or anyone with mobility challenges. Bathrooms are prone to wet surfaces, making slip-and-fall accidents a common risk. Opting for non-slip flooring during a remodel is a proactive measure to enhance safety and prevent injuries. It's also a good choice for high-traffic bathrooms or if you simply desire added peace of mind, knowing your flooring contributes to a safer environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider non-slip flooring during a remodel if safety is a priority, especially for households with children, seniors, or those with mobility issues, or if you want to proactively prevent falls.
